---
title: "Mailing List"
---

EADM maintains a mailing list for its members.

To subscribe, please fill in the form below. Please use a valid institutional email address. Every request is checked and validated by hand by the <a href="mailto:michael@eadm.eu">webmaster</a> before you are added to the list, so it may take a moment until your subscription is active.

```{=html}
<!-- The site is static, so Web3Forms (web3forms.com) relays each request to
the webmaster by email. The access key is tied to michael@eadm.eu and is meant
to be public. The hCaptcha widget must be solved before the form submits, and
botcheck is a hidden honeypot field that catches simple bots. -->
<form id="mailing-list-form" action="https://api.web3forms.com/submit" method="POST" class="my-4" style="max-width: 36rem;">
  <input type="hidden" name="access_key" value="d5580530-f99a-4387-b0cc-3d678b094cfe">
  <input type="hidden" name="subject" value="EADM mailing list: subscription request">
  <input type="hidden" name="from_name" value="EADM website">
  <input type="checkbox" name="botcheck" style="display: none;" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
  <input type="hidden" name="redirect" id="mailing-list-redirect">
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="ml-family-name" class="form-label">Family name</label>
    <input type="text" class="form-control" id="ml-family-name" name="Family name" autocomplete="family-name" required>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="ml-first-name" class="form-label">First name</label>
    <input type="text" class="form-control" id="ml-first-name" name="First name" autocomplete="given-name" required>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="ml-email" class="form-label">Email (institutional)</label>
    <input type="email" class="form-control" id="ml-email" name="email" autocomplete="email" required>
  </div>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="ml-affiliation" class="form-label">Affiliation</label>
    <input type="text" class="form-control" id="ml-affiliation" name="Affiliation" autocomplete="organization" required>
  </div>
  <div class="h-captcha mb-3" data-captcha="true"></div>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Subscribe</button>
</form>

<script src="https://web3forms.com/client/script.js" async defer></script>
<script>
  // Web3Forms needs an absolute URL to return to, and the site runs both on
  // the GitHub Pages preview and on eadm.eu, so it is built at runtime.
  document.getElementById("mailing-list-redirect").value =
    new URL("mailing-list-thanks.html", window.location.href).href;
</script>
```

If you want to send an email to the list do so via <a href="mailto:eadm.imu@lists.unibe.ch">eadm.imu@lists.unibe.ch</a>. Given that you are subscribed this email will be distributed immediately. If you are not subscribed it will be stored for moderation.

&nbsp;
